title: Is the guidance on How Syncing Works still current?

question.author: member_247
question.body: I found an older discussion about how syncing works. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sync Engine documentation says: Changes made on any device propagate to all other linked devices and to the cloud. The client icon shows the current state: green for up to date, spinning blue for syncing, and red for an error. Pausing sync (right-click the tray icon > Pause) stops all transfers until you resume. CloudBox uses block-level delta sync: when a file changes, only the changed blocks are transferred, so a small edit to a large file syncs in seconds. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
